# Instructions for GitHub Copilot / VS Code

Follow the project rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

When working on Lukulu Academy:
- Use the `develop` branch and protect `main`.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes to `index.html` and `student-hub.html`.
- Preserve all existing Student Hub and DAW functionality.
- Run `node tests/student-hub-smoke.cjs` where Node.js is available; explain any untested Mac-specific interactions.
- Do not overwrite local edits or pull with force.
- Do not add secrets or real student data.
- Ask before payment integration, production deployment, approval-gated student record changes or changing prices.
- Keep the app compatible with macOS Catalina's available tooling.
